keyFindings.description: The approval lookup still has two orchestrations: attachApprovals (reviews.go:204) runs approvalTargets, latestReviewsStatement, openApprovalAsksStatement and applyApprovals one statement at a time, and queueArtifactDetails' approval half (artifacts.go:1164) runs the same steps in a batch. They have already drifted (the batched copy's send failure lacks the prefix; the scans' leading rows.Err() exists only to imitate the other path). Split the approval half into one queue-and-apply that attachApprovals sends as a batch of its own, and have loadArtifactRow use loadArtifactDetails for its one artifact (two statements and three round trips become one batch).
